_comment: LAB.md §A 「肩書と名簿」 (2026-10-04): what a client shows where a person's title (肩書) is shown. roster: the person's lab roster line (null off the roster); its label is the roster's short label (教授 / 准教授 / 講師 / 助教 / 教員 for faculty without a rank, the grade or 学生 for a student, その他, 卒業生). title: users.title as the server sends it. display: the line a client shows (null: nothing): the title trimmed when there is no label; the label when the title is empty or the same as the label (compared after NFKC, trimming and lower-casing); otherwise 「<label> · <title>」. extra: what a list that already shows the label as a badge adds after it: the title when it is not empty and not the same as the label, else null. Hand-written; desktop (tests/titleDisplay.test.ts), iOS (TitleDisplayTests) and Android (TitleDisplayTest) read this file.
